verses.1: When Israel left Egypt, the house of Jacob was separated from the people of Lot.
verses.2: Judea was the sacred land of Israel, ruled by its rulers.
verses.3: The sea saw that the Jordan River would be divided into two parts.
verses.4: The mountains danced like wild oxen, like columns of stone.
verses.5: What is the sea doing? The Jordan River has turned into a river of blood.
verses.6: The mountains danced like wild oxen, like the buildings of a city.
verses.7: Before Adonai Huli, before the Lord Jacob.
verses.8: The turning of the shape into a sea-like appearance is like a dreamy vision of a sea.
